result.summary: Independently reproduced TEST-DESIGNER's and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's claimed counts from a cold start on branch feature/WF02-REQ040-20260817 (HEAD 4db3647, working tree clean). Postgres (letflow-postgres-1, port 5462) already up/healthy; toolchain (Erlang/OTP 29, Elixir 1.20.3, Mix 1.20.3) reachable locally, no Docker-fallback needed. Ran `mix test` three separate times: (1) full suite, unpinned seed 384064 -- 'Result: 673 passed (4 properties, 669 tests)', exit 0, 0 failures, zero matches on a failure-marker regex over the full 16,118-line raw log; (2) full suite, pinned seed 0 -- identical 'Result: 673 passed (4 properties, 669 tests)', exit 0, 0 failures, zero matches over the 16,048-line raw log; (3) isolated run of test/letflow/definitions/promotion_assertion_rerun_test.exs + test/letflow/definitions_test.exs, unpinned seed 324606 -- 'Result: 32 passed', exit 0, 0 failures, exactly matching TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's claimed 12 (new file) + 20 (definitions_test.exs, 4 new) breakdown. Count arithmetic verified against the task-cited main baseline: 657 + 16 new tests = 673 total / 653 + 16 = 669 example tests / 4 properties unchanged -- matches both full-suite runs exactly. Took the SandboxPool-flakiness warning seriously: compared all three runs' seeds/results (all identical pass counts, no retries or intermittent results), grepped both full-suite logs for sandbox_unavailable/pool-timeout/max_wait/retry-related text outside the known OIDC noise (zero matches in either log), and grepped every [error] line across all three logs (only the known pre-existing OIDC placeholder-issuer connection-retry noise appeared -- 6/4/1 occurrences respectively, varying only with each run's wall-clock duration since it's a periodic retry timer -- nothing SandboxPool- or REQ-040-related). No flakiness or timing sensitivity found. Investigated all 10 compiler warnings present in run1's log before dismissing them as noise: ran `git diff main...HEAD --stat` (19-file diff: handoffs/, lib/letflow/definitions.ex, lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_artifact.ex, lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_assertion_run.ex, lib/letflow/design/req040-promotion-assertion-rerun.md, lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex, the new migration file, the two REQ-040 test files, test/specs/REQ-040.md) and confirmed none of the five warning-source test files (fixture_loader_test.exs, service_scope_validator_test.exs, claim_mapping_property_test.exs, event_store/registry_test.exs, search_test.exs) appear in it; `git log --oneline -1` on each confirms all were last touched by unrelated prior merged commits (REQ-039, REQ-042, REQ-017, REQ-024). lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex's 20-line diff was itself inspected and is exactly the expected REQ-040 migration-manifest registration (11th tenant-scoped entry, per the design doc's own §4 guard-pattern requirement), not an unrelated change. Zero pre-existing failures found anywhere in the suite. No new docs/issues/ISS-NNNN.yaml entry needed -- nothing unrelated failed, and git log main..HEAD -- docs/issues/ is empty for this branch (no issue was filed upstream in this run's pipeline either, unlike REQ-038's). Report written to test/reports/report-2026-08-18-WF02-REQ040-20260817.yaml following the REQ-038 report's format.
